brief: Morrow Rooms rents meeting rooms by the hour to small teams in Portland, Oregon. Visitors compare rooms, review a reservation and manage meeting preferences. Review these five independent screen states, not a tested end-to-end booking flow. The confirmation page is a separately initialized successful reservation. The pages are static snapshots; backend payment execution, persistence and behavior after pressing an action are outside this review. Evaluate what is visible and measured, including the wording of an action's consequences.
